title: More fragments

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any luck with those fragments?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Let me see… where did you find these, at the bottom of a crusher? But wait, there, is that a pair of folded hands? A fish? A half moon?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me see… where did you find these, at the bottom of a crusher? But wait, there, is that a pair of folded hands? A fish? A half moon?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Your secret, right. Hmm. Do you know the story about Helix Monumental?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your secret, right. Hmm. Do you know the story about Helix Monumental?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: People say the woman who designed it vanished at the halfway point between the loops one day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People say the woman who designed it vanished at the halfway point between the loops one day.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Too bad. Stories are what hold this city together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Too bad. Stories are what hold this city together.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: We've all tried it once. Maybe it will work for you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We've all tried it once. Maybe it will work for you!

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: How sad for the rest of us if that's true.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How sad for the rest of us if that's true.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: That could mean Beyond the Western Limit… and this node, I might be able to fix it...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That could mean Beyond the Western Limit… and this node, I might be able to fix it...

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Apparently, she’d accidentally created a divine spiral and ascended to a different plane of consciousness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Apparently, she’d accidentally created a divine spiral and ascended to a different plane of consciousness.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: People say that even now, if you run around it six times at sunset, you’ll attain enlightenment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People say that even now, if you run around it six times at sunset, you’ll attain enlightenment.
I think so...
So, my secret?
I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: On second thoughts, no time for stories now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: On second thoughts, no time for stories now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: On second thoughts, no time for stories now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: On second thoughts, no time for stories now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Totally going to try that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Perhaps enlightenment is knowing not to believe silly stories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps enlightenment is knowing not to believe silly stories.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Perhaps enlightenment is knowing not to believe silly stories.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Perhaps enlightenment is knowing not to believe silly stories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Take a look!
Fascinating!
Errr .... sure.
Where's my payment?
